ingredients: 2 cups prepared filling: white cheese, minced meat, chicken, or spinach
Melted butter or high-quality vegetable oil
steps: Unfold phyllo carefully, lay flat and cover with a clean damp tea towel to prevent drying.
Cut sheets lengthwise into thirds. Lay out one strip and keep the others covered.
Brush with melted butter and place a heaped teaspoon of filling at one end.
Fold the lower right corner upward over the filling into a triangle, then fold the upper right corner to the left. Continue folding to the end of the strip.
Trim excess dough and seal the final edge with a damp finger, pressing firmly.
Fry in oil at 340°F until golden brown or bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.

ingredients: 1 medium-large eggplant (1 to 1½ pounds), any variety
Paprika or cayenne pepper for garnish
steps: Roast eggplant until flesh is cooked and skin burned and loose. One method is to prick it and broil a few inches below the heat, turning as the skin blackens every 3–4 minutes. Catch juices in a pan and discard them.
Scrape off the skin; a few burned bits may remain.
Finely chop or blend the flesh with the remaining ingredients until smooth, reserving some olive oil to drizzle on top. Sprinkle with paprika or cayenne.

steps: Combine ¼ cup brown sugar, chili powder, garlic powder, cayenne, salt and pepper. Rub meat side of ribs and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Combine paprika, tomato paste, molasses, remaining brown sugar and vinegar in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat and reduce by half. Set aside.
Put smoking wood in a roasting pan, add a rack, and place ribs on it.
Cover with foil and cook in the center of a 200°F oven for 6 hours, brushing with sauce every hour.
Remove foil, brush meat side liberally with sauce and broil until well browned.
Cut into single-rib portions and serve warm with remaining sauce.
